Did You Know a Melting Candy Bar Invented the Microwave? 🍫

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 In 1945, Raytheon engineer Percy Spencer was testing military radar magnetrons when he noticed the chocolate bar in his pocket had melted. He then pointed the magnetron at popcorn kernels — and they popped.
